name: benchmark-bundlers
description: Reproducible benchmark harness for Webpack, Vite, Rspack, and Turbopack

scripts.bench:all: pnpm bench:dev:spa && pnpm bench:build:spa && pnpm bench:dev:next && pnpm bench:build:next
scripts.bench:smoke:spa: node scripts/bench/run-dev-bench.mjs --track spa --smoke && node scripts/bench/run-build-bench.mjs --track spa --smoke
scripts.bench:smoke:next: node scripts/bench/run-dev-bench.mjs --track next --smoke && node scripts/bench/run-build-bench.mjs --track next --smoke
